NCRPO ON FULL ALERT FOR NOV. 30 RALLY

UPDATE: Palace Press Officer Claire Castro says the Metro Manila police force is on full alert as of Friday, Nov. 28, for "maximum police presence and proper deployment" ahead of the second “Trillion Peso March” on Sunday, Nov. 30. 

She said more than 15,000 police personnel will be deployed for the gathering. 

The rally organizers said they aim to raise the stakes against corruption and political dynasties, but will not seek the resignation of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and Vice President Sara Duterte.

data.text:
Is Marcos Dragging PH Into Russia’s Crosshairs???

So… now Marcos Jr.’s government is tinkering with Russia’s red lines too? Seriously?? Because apparently mishandling the South China Sea, antagonizing China and ASEAN, fumbling the economy, drowning in massive corruption scandals, and hemorrhaging domestic legitimacy weren’t enough — now we’re adding Russia to the list of offended major powers. My god!!! PH is inviting one disaster after another under Marcos Jr.’s presidency. Is it not? 

According to the Russian Foreign Ministry, a “coordinated campaign” is happening on PH soil to recruit Filipinos for combat duty in Ukraine, allegedly with U.S. involvement, U.S. instructors providing training at a facility outside San Fernando, and mercenaries getting even assistance to secure Schengen visas through Manila’s German Embassy. If this is true, which I would presume it is, because Russian intelligence is quite good, my goodness! WTF!!!?? 

You know what, folks, if my reading and analysis are correct, Moscow sees this as direct participation in the Ukraine conflict — a red line it has repeatedly stated. Let’s break down how reckless this looks:

1. Russia would see this as foreign interference — and as a U.S. operation using PH soil that alone brings the Philippines into Russia’s strategic crosshairs. For Moscow, foreign fighters in Ukraine are not “volunteers.” They are mercenaries acting on behalf of the host state. And in this regard, PH could be considered and labeled “a participant” in a European war we have zero business entangling ourselves in.

2. This paints PH as a proxy playground. It is as if PH, being a chess piece in the U.S.–China rivalry, wasn’t already risky enough; now we’re inserting ourselves into the U.S.-Ukraine–Russia confrontation, too. What’s next under a Marcos Jr. presidency?? North Korea? Iran? Kakaloka!!  

3. Under a Marcos Presidency, PH is now perceived by the world at large as aligning with every U.S. military agenda on the planet:  

South China Sea – Check!
Taiwan Strait? – Check!
Ukraine front – Check! 

Seriously? WTF!!

Russia’s spokesperson Maria Zakharova did not mince words. Her narrative is straightforward: The Philippines is letting U.S. private military recruiters operate freely, train Filipinos, ship them to Ukraine, and issue European visas through Western embassies, officially stamped, broadcast on RT, and circulated globally.

And take note, Russia does not make accusations like this lightly. When Russia signals a red line, it means: We are watching you very closely.

What’s wrong with this move? Everything! Absolutely everything! It drags PH into Europe’s bloodiest conflict since WWII. It threatens our diplomatic ties with Russia. It risks retaliation. It shows the Marcos Jr. government doesn’t even understand the basics of foreign policy risk management, and it makes the Philippines appear reckless, unserious, and manipulable.

And worst of all: Filipinos — already desperate under a collapsing economy — are the ones being pushed into dangerous foreign battlefields by geopolitical games they don’t even understand. Is this one catastrophe after another under a Marcos Jr. Presidency? 

What kind of foreign policy is this??? Foreign policy by Sabit (forced entanglement)?? By accident? By sheer incompetence?

The Philippines should be stabilizing relationships, not igniting crises on every continent.

But here we are — making enemies out of nuclear powers left and right, one press briefing at a time.

My fellow Filipinos, Marcos Jr.’s administration is ALLERGIC to PEACE, STABILITY, with NO GEOPOLITICAL COMMON SENSE! 

In this case, A CHANGE OF LEADERSHIP IS A MUST IN PH SOON! 
#ProPhilippines
